svg.aria-label: Searching the knowledge base. Track 1 embeds the question, pulls 20 candidate chunks from ChromaDB and re-ranks them to keep the best 5. Track 2 enters the graph by alias at 'NDIR reading drift', hops RESOLVED_BY to the NDIR calibration SOP and CONTAINS to its three steps, under a 6 second, 4 step budget
svg.text: q: "what do i do if the ndir reading drifts?"
